title: Code Mode execution trace
description: Structured content returned by the `codemode` and `codemode_ui` tools. Mirrors the schema built at crates/labby/src/mcp/handlers_tools.rs:686-765 and advertised via Tool::with_raw_output_schema; the Rust builder remains the runtime source of truth. NOTE (SPEC FR-7): the error trace at crates/labby/src/mcp/call_tool_codemode.rs:659-670 omits `logs_count`, which `required` below demands — the success path supplies it via crates/labby-codemode/src/trace.rs:134. Because that trace carries isError:true it is exempt from conformance, so this is an internal inconsistency for trace consumers, NOT a protocol violation; reconcile by adding logs_count: 0. Dated: logs_count required 2026-06-08 (68cc3b8aa), error path added 2026-07-11 (bf75ed4ac).

execution_id.description: Correlates the trace with the durable step journal and stored execution source.

error_kind.description: Present only on failed runs. Stable kind per docs/dev/ERRORS.md.

error.description: Present only on failed runs. Structured error payload.

calls.description: One entry per in-sandbox callTool invocation, in start order. Must remain structured even when the top-level result is truncated.

resourceUri.description: Native MCP UI resource URI returned by the upstream tool for this call.

result.description: The sandbox return value. Deliberately unconstrained so that a truncation marker string (crates/labby-codemode/src/shape.rs:99-135) is a conforming value.

content_type.description: Simple ASCII type/subtype media type for the artifact receipt.
